title: valeriana capitata subsp. pubicarpa
intro: Valeriana capitata subsp. pubicarpa, commonly known as Valerian pubicarpa, is a plant species within the Valerianaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its sedative and anxiolytic effects, helping to promote relaxation and reduce stress levels. The health benefits of Valerian pubicarpa include improved sleep quality, reduced anxiety, and relief from muscle and joint pain. The therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including valepotriates, isovaleric acid, and valerenic acid, which have been shown to have sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties.
